items.headline: Retargeting springs mid-flight in CSS with linear()
items.summary: An interrupted drawer keeps its velocity by sampling current progress and building a new linear() easing. The article ships a 40-line helper.
items.why: Copy the helper for drawers and toasts that users interrupt.

items.headline: Noise-driven gradient shaders with per-frame costs on mid-range phones
items.summary: Three noise functions produce soft UI gradients, with a reusable GLSL snippet. A table lists frame cost on mid-range phones.
items.why: Pick the cheapest noise function before shipping a shader background.

items.headline: Radix navigation menu 2.1.0 adds safe-triangle hover intent
items.summary: Nested submenus now use a safe triangle to decide hover intent. Focus also returns to the trigger when Escape closes a panel.
items.why: Replace fixed hover delays in custom submenus with the same triangle test.

items.headline: Safe triangle cuts submenu mis-selections by 31 percent in a 48-person study
items.summary: A cursor study compares three submenu hover strategies. The safe triangle beat a fixed delay on mis-selections.
items.why: Cite the 31 percent figure when defending the triangle in design reviews.

items.headline: Four measures for agent UIs: first useful signal, correction cost, interruptions, recovery
items.summary: Proposes first useful signal, correction cost, interruptions and recovery as the measures, with two worked examples.
items.why: Measure an agent flow against all four before adding features.
